title: fix(pm): dispatch-gates derives the change set with -z, so a non-ASCII governed path keeps its tier
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi916SWCJMeiaqJP9Bb2wnp2s)_

Fixes #33847

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:派发工具 `dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `changedPathsFromGit` 读变更路径(已提交、未提交、未跟踪三份清单)时改成加 `-z`、按 NUL 切分,三份清单走同一个读取函数,`-z` 由该函数统一插入。
- 为什么改:不加 `-z` 时 git 会把含中文等非 ASCII 字符或换行的路径打印成带引号的转义串,它对不上任何 glob,于是 `skills/**` 下这样命名的受管文件在派发时算不出复审档位,派生的门禁清单也漏掉它;未跟踪的这种文件还被记成「读不到、0 行」。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `scripts/pm/**` 一个工具脚本和它的自测,不发布任何包;所有 ASCII 路径的读数逐字节不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` 的 `gitPathList`(新读取函数)与 `changedPathsFromGit` 的三处调用;自测文件里 `quoted-names` 场景。
- 两分钟验证:在一个分支上提交 `skills/objectstack-data/文档.md` 后跑 `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`,预期 stderr 列出原样的中文路径,stdout 给出契约复审档位(修复前是带引号的转义串、无档位)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(非受管面)。

## What changes

`changedPathsFromGit` (it feeds `--tier`, `--commands` and the changed-line size) read its three path lists line by line, with no `-z`:

| Read | Was | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|
| committed | `diff --name-only --no-renames MERGE_BASE HEAD`, split on newline, trimmed | `diff -z --name-only --no-renames MERGE_BASE HEAD`, split on NUL, not trimmed |
| working tree | `diff --name-only --no-renames HEAD`, same | `diff -z …`, same |
| untracked | `ls-files --others --exclude-standard`, same | `ls-files -z …`, same |
| `changedLinesFromGit` fallback (no `untracked` passed) | the untracked read above | the same `-z` read |

Git C-quotes a path holding a non-ASCII byte, a double quote or a control character (a file named in Chinese prints as a quoted octal string), and that spelling starts with a quote mark, so it matched no glob. Measured on a real repo before the fix: a committed `skills/x/` file named in Chinese plus an untracked one derived `tier: null`, and the untracked one was counted as 1 unreadable file of 0 lines. After: both raw, tier `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, 0 unreadable.

All four reads now go through one reader, `gitPathList`, which splices `-z` in after the subcommand itself, so no caller in this file can list paths the other way. The old `gitLines` had no other caller and is gone. Not done, per the card: `core.quotePath=false` alone, which would still split a newline name in two.

Not changed: the size read `diff --numstat -M` (summed by `parseNumstat` in `check-governed-merges.mjs`) only adds the two counts, which quoting never touches; the same call was left as is in #33804 for the same reason.

## Tests

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` on acb82a3e: **2520 cases pass**, exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). Five new cases, in the slow tier's real-git section, on a fixture repo that sets `core.quotePath true` itself so it quotes on any machine. Each of the three reads carries one name git quotes: a committed file named in Chinese, an uncommitted edit to another, and an untracked file whose name holds a newline.

- CONTROL: the plain read (no `-z`) of the same branch quotes all three, and they derive no tier and name no gate family.
- The derived change set lists each name raw (committed 1, worktree 1, untracked 1).
- Those raw names derive `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` through `skills/**` (3 hits).
- They name `check:skill-*` gate families, the ones the derived `--commands` list is built from.
- The untracked newline-named file is counted from disk: 0 unreadable, +3 lines.

No existing test was edited.

<details><summary>Ablation: the old reader restored on disk, exactly the four new rows red, restored (head acb82a3e)</summary>

Each mutation through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hits 1 then 0 on disk, blob changed), the self-test under `os-verify-lock.sh`; restore: blob == HEAD (`6343de57fbce`) and `git diff HEAD` empty, both legs.

```text
leg 2 (the card's ablation): gitPathList body back to the old gitLines body
  (no -z, split on newline, trimmed)                 -> VERDICT command-exit 1, 4 of 2520 failed:
  the derived change set spells each C-quoted name as it is on disk: committed, uncommitted and untracked (newline included)
  and those raw names derive the contract-review tier through the skills/** glob
  and they name the skill gate families the derived --commands list is built from
  and the untracked newline-named file is counted from disk, not as an unreadable file of 0 lines
  (the CONTROL row stays green, as it must)
leg 1: only the spliced -z dropped, NUL split kept   -> VERDICT command-exit 1, 12 of 2520 failed:
  the four rows above, plus 8 older real-git derivation rows: without -z
  the whole newline-joined listing comes back as ONE name, so -z and the
  NUL split are bound in one reader and cannot drift apart
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Every ASCII path reads byte-identically: the 2515 cases that existed before all stay green on the fix.
- `derivationProvenance` prints one path per stderr line, so a path with a newline in its name now prints raw across two lines there. That is display only (stdout and the tier are unaffected); not changed.
- Serial: #33848 edits the same two files and waits for this PR to merge.

## Verification

Local subset on acb82a3e (final head): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 30 commands; all 30 exit 0 (each exit captured before any pipe). `--ran` with every line annotated `:: exit N`: **30 derived, 30 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (a derived zero, all 30 recorded an exit code). `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` is in that 30 (its fast tier, 2205 cases); the full both-tier battery is the 2520 above. The script's other callers of `changedPathsFromGit` are only `check-dispatch-gates.mjs`, covered there. No package touched, so no build closure and no package test is owed; CI runs the rest.
